default_install_dir.description: The default directory path where tools are installed if no custom path is provided.

tools.description: List of available Aricma tools and CLI binaries mapped in the registry.

name.description: The command-line friendly name of the tool (e.g., 'my-tui').

description.description: A short summary of what the tool does, useful for installer prompts or help menus.

binary_name.description: The actual executable file name built in the release assets.
